title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
summary: 以「敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐」為研究主題，規劃拆解地質風險、開挖支護、防水與變形監測。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs. Planned coverage includes geological risks, excavation support, waterproofing and deformation monitoring. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
